{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose a login prompt reachable at telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is confirmed.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A launch log or receipt showing the VM was started with host port 6665 forwarded to guest telnet/serial login access"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU remains running in the background after launch","Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 shows an Alpine login prompt","The task blocks until the prompt is observed"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying that files exist","Only checking that QEMU starts without confirming the login prompt","Leaving QEMU in the foreground or exiting before readiness","Forwarding the wrong port or exposing a service that is not the login prompt"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace and available receipts for prior launch attempts","Launch QEMU detached with hostfwd or equivalent console forwarding to 127.0.0.1:6665","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed","Keep the VM running after successful probe"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed launch command/output showing QEMU started successfully","Receipt-backed probe output showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["Preserve the original request over any derived state conflicts.","Use receipts instead of repeating equivalent commands."]},{"type":"plan_update","content":"First inspect visible files and any prior receipts, then launch QEMU with a backgrounded process and port forwarding to 6665, then probe the endpoint until the login prompt appears."},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect workspace contents and receipts","Determine QEMU invocation for alpine.iso","Launch QEMU in background with port 6665 exposed","Probe localhost:6665 for login prompt","Leave VM running once ready"]}]}
{"actions":[{"type":"raw_bash","command":"find /app -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^/app/##' | sort","timeout_seconds":30}]}
